title: Two samplers, one schedule: leftover noise
hook: Stop a run part-way with its noise still in, hand it on, and finish with another sampler or model. Three settings make it work and each one fails differently.

verified.claim: return_with_leftover_noise disable sets force_full_denoise, which sets the last kept sigma to 0.
add_noise disable uses a zero noise tensor.
start_at_step at or past the end returns the latent unchanged.
dpmpp_2m keeps the previous prediction in a local variable, so a new call starts without it.

unchecked: All numbers come from a one-dimensional toy with a perfect denoiser, which forgives some mistakes a real model may not. We did not render the failure cases on a real model for this lesson.
Whether a sampler change part-way helps a real picture is an open question here. We have no render that shows it.
